answer: Give every identity a score that rots: halve influence each epoch unless renewed by peer-attested useful work, like a terrace that slumps back to hillside without constant tending. A whisper of past glory earns nothing; only this epoch's verified jobs rebuild weight, and one proof refreshes exactly one identity, never the fleet. Running N sybils then costs N full workloads per epoch, every epoch, while the beacon of accumulated standing shines only on agents who keep showing up. The farmer's math never improves with age.
